text:
ITEM 1 | Red seedless grapes in a loose cluster of about 20 berries, glossy deep red to purple with a few paler green-yellow ones, smooth skin, round, about 1.5-2 cm each; piled 2 cm high, upper-left of the plate beside the almonds | 80 g
ITEM 2 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, flat and glossy with visible pale midribs and stems, some leaves whole and some torn, spread across the left and lower part of the plate, leaves about 8-12 cm long, thin and lightly layered | 55 g
ITEM 3 | Whole almonds, brown with a matte, slightly papery skin and pointed oval shape about 2.5 cm long, scattered in a loose pile on the right side of the plate, roughly 2 cm high, with no coating, browning or glaze | 40 g
